title: Bukidnon leads Northern Mindanao in 26th Gawad Kalasag awards

blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Thirteen local government units (LGUs) in Bukidnon received gold awards during the 26th Gawad Kalasag National and Regional Awarding ceremony on Tuesday, Nov. 24, in Cagayan de Oro City, giving the province the most top awardees in Northern Mindanao (Region 10). Data from the Office of Civil Defense (OCD) Region 10
